main.description: ATSMS per-DID inbound-delivery record: where to reach this identity. A singleton (rkey 'self'), discovered with a single getRecord. Payload-agnostic — it addresses the DCGKA sealed-envelope path and the stateless one-shot path alike. Supersedes the retired per-device inviteAddress (inbound-delivery.md §3).

endpoints.description: Delivery endpoints ordered by preference (most-preferred first). A sender uses the first URI scheme it understands. At least one mailto: endpoint MUST be present (the SMTP interop floor).

endpoint.description: One delivery endpoint. The URI scheme is the transport: mailto: = SMTP floor (deliver as an application/atsms-envelope attachment), https: = POST the payload. Unknown schemes are ignored by senders that don't understand them.
